[Wiadro] i normally use LIQUI MOLY Petrol Injection Cleaner 300 ml
[GunnerMcDagget] These things are pretty useless. They do work but only if your fuel injectors are actually blocked. And if they are actually blocked, it means you put some really bad fuel in your car (something with heavy metal deposits or other sediment) and if that's the case, this will only provide a temporary solution until you get your full fuel system drained and flushed by a mechanic.
It also doesn't do most of the things it claims to do. The primary use of something like this is to prevent fuel degradation if you are storing the fuel for more than 6 months before using. If you're filling up at the petrol station every time you run out of fuel, this is useless.

[Fuzor] What is the difference between using and not using this on a vehicle with direct injection? From research, it seems like whether the bottle has PEA or not, it is not going to be able to clean the carbon off the injectors if you have a modern direct injection engine. It simply cannot reach that area to clean, so then what is the actual clean that is needed that normal detergents in petrol cannot do?
[GunnerMcDagget] It generally doesn't clean most build up off the injectors. This is similar to a fuel additive they put in any high quality fuel. It's designed to clean out build up but generally it doesn't do much unless you use it everytime you refuel. And even then, it doesn't provide that much of an impact.
This is primarily a placebo to keep people happy. It's similar to the issues surrounding E10. Most mechanics will tell you that even if your car is rated as "E10", you shouldn't use it because it will destroy your engine. Fuel chemists will tell you that E10 will not damage your engine at all unless it's not compatible with E10. The fuel chemists I have worked with have also told me that these things are pretty useless. Their advice was, "if you're really worried about your fuel system, two tanks of good quality fuel is more effective"
But using this stuff isn't going to cause issues so if you want to, go for it. Just don't use Engine Flushes. They can actually destroy the seals in your engine and cause many other problems.
